help.stdout:
usage: thermal_comfort [-h] [--version] --base_path BASE_PATH --date DATE
                       [--building_dsm BUILDING_DSM] [--dem DEM]
                       [--trees TREES] [--landcover LANDCOVER]
                       [--tile_size TILE_SIZE] [--overlap OVERLAP]
                       [--use_own_met USE_OWN_MET] [--own_metfile OWN_METFILE]
                       [--data_source_type DATA_SOURCE_TYPE]
                       [--data_folder DATA_FOLDER] [--start START] [--end END]
                       [--era5_z0_find ERA5_Z0_FIND] [--use_uhi USE_UHI]
                       [--save_tmrt SAVE_TMRT] [--save_svf SAVE_SVF]
                       [--save_kup SAVE_KUP] [--save_kdown SAVE_KDOWN]
                       [--save_lup SAVE_LUP] [--save_ldown SAVE_LDOWN]
                       [--save_shadow SAVE_SHADOW] [--save_wbgt SAVE_WBGT]
                       [--save_ta SAVE_TA] [--save_wind SAVE_WIND]

Run SOLWEIG with GPU acceleration.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --base_path BASE_PATH
                        Base directory containing input data
  --date DATE           Date for which thermal comfort is computed (e.g.,
                        2021-07-01)
  --building_dsm BUILDING_DSM
                        Building DSM raster filename
  --dem DEM             DEM raster filename
  --trees TREES         Trees raster filename
  --landcover LANDCOVER
                        Landcover raster filename (optional)
  --tile_size TILE_SIZE
                        Tile size in pixels (e.g., 100–4000)
  --overlap OVERLAP     Tile overlap in pixels (less than tile_size)
  --use_own_met USE_OWN_MET
                        Use your own meteorological file (True/False)
  --own_metfile OWN_METFILE
                        Path to your own meteorological file (UMEP-format text
                        file)
  --data_source_type DATA_SOURCE_TYPE
                        Meteorological source (ERA5 or wrfout)
  --data_folder DATA_FOLDER
                        Directory containing ERA5/WRF data files
  --start START         Start time in UTC (e.g., '2020-08-12 00:00:00')
  --end END             End time in UTC (e.g., '2020-08-12 23:00:00')
  --era5_z0_find ERA5_Z0_FIND
                        Compute directional wind-extension coefficients from
                        ERA5 forecast surface roughness; requires data_stream-
                        oper_stepType-instant.nc in --data_folder. Defaults to
                        True when --data_folder is provided, False otherwise
                        (True/False)
  --use_uhi USE_UHI     Compute diagnostic urban heat island intensity (ERA5
                        forcing only; set False for WRF or own met file)
                        (True/False)
  --save_tmrt SAVE_TMRT
                        Save mean radiant temperature output
  --save_svf SAVE_SVF   Save sky view factor output
  --save_kup SAVE_KUP   Save upward shortwave radiation output
  --save_kdown SAVE_KDOWN
                        Save downward shortwave radiation output
  --save_lup SAVE_LUP   Save upward longwave radiation output
  --save_ldown SAVE_LDOWN
                        Save downward longwave radiation output
  --save_shadow SAVE_SHADOW
                        Save shadow map output
  --save_wbgt SAVE_WBGT
                        Save wet bulb globe temperature output
  --save_ta SAVE_TA     Save diagnostic air temperature output
  --save_wind SAVE_WIND
                        Save diagnostic wind speed output
